P0_TRUST_CLOSURE_CONTAMINATION.description: Issues that contaminate trust, closure, or evidence integrity
P0_TRUST_CLOSURE_CONTAMINATION.rule: P0 issues MUST be resolved before any feature expansion or new DRY mission

P1_RECURRENCE_PREVENTION.description: Harden verifier/factoryctl/contract/negative control gates against known issues
P1_RECURRENCE_PREVENTION.rule: Each P0 issue must have a corresponding P1 gate implemented before the next DRY phase

P2_FEATURE_EXPANSION.description: Feature expansion or complex DRY mission
P2_FEATURE_EXPANSION.rule: Only allowed when P0 is clean AND P1 is adequate
